name: Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket)
version_note: Documented from source of the 2.1.20 stable release (newest on the 2.1.x branch).
project_description:
New free Drupal store module (alternative to Drupal Commerce). With this module you can create a fully functional online store on CMS Drupal, which works immediately after installation.

 The module can be extended based on plugins that are implemented in it and which give it great flexibility and adaptability for different tasks. All this ensures the development of the store in accordance with modern requirements and standards of e-commerce.

 Features: works simultaneously with many node types as products; has its own price field and works only with it; customization system for currencies, delivery and payment systems; order management with filter / export / print invoices; e-mail notifications about new orders; template system (twig editor) editable directly from the admin panel with preview.

 Advantages: simple installation; can be installed on an existing project; flexible and adaptable; works with basic php settings (no advanced php required).

 Dependencies: Node, Token, SCSS/Less Compiler, Views. Optional: set $config['basket']['not_use_session'] = TRUE in settings.php to run the cart without PHP sessions.
